authority: User active goal: 按照这个计划完成V0.5
coordinate_rule: At room r in main episode e, explore iff (e+3*r+case_index)%10==7; exploratory command=(e//10+r+case_index)%2. Same vector for all queries on that main task; no random draws.
ordinary_learning: All real episodes update categorical executed-action transitions and current controller-version command observations exactly once; RP/R also apply chronological physical-action TD alpha=.5 gamma=1. No private learned state is copied.
physical_action_TD_basis: World transition depends on the actually executed action, not the requested command; both physical actions remain reachable under the initial swap. Controller versions condition command models, not immutable physical transition/Q facts.
F_policy: Goal search over nominal layered graph and learned categorical edges; prefer known progressing edges, otherwise unknown frontier. No Q attribute, return labels or reward features.
P_selection: Rotate current candidate catalogue by one position per main failure; execute at most two sequential candidates, learning each real episode immediately; stop on SUCCESS.
S_selection: Prefer a terminal mismatch repair only if commanded nominal edge is not already known blocked; otherwise current ordinary plan, alternative, then edits. Exact current-engine controller/program/coordinate query matches may reuse owned observations without learning twice.
candidate_catalogue: keep; remove_first; if multiple visible mismatches remove_last and joint; ordinary action alternative at last observed failed decision. Repairs replay observed command prefix; remaining rooms use updated ordinary policy.
acceptance: Prefer observed goal attainment or strictly longer reachable prefix; ties keep. An edit requires all changed addresses actually consulted with nominal execution in the selected real trial. Never edit protected/unread addresses.
truth_boundary: Passable exits and full controller source are audit-only. Agent receives PublicTask, factual Feedback, public intervention revision tags, current-visible candidates, and engineering coins. Reward packet exists only for RP/R.
scope: Six deterministic engineering cases, not independent seeds; no unseen transfer or statistics. Same number of controller remaps and protected sentinels at every difficulty; topology depth only changes.
